snippets.snippet_text: "Will I have to pay? No, you won't have to spend a cent. Domestika will take care of the course production costs and, on top of that, you'll earn money."
"What do I need in order to receive payments for my courses? All you need is a PayPal account. As soon as we verify it, we'll send you the instructions so that you can easily receive the payments."

"Any professional in the creative field. A team of professionals is responsible for reviewing every proposal in detail to ensure that it meets Domestika's quality standards. In addition to your course proposal, it's essential that you send all the necessary information so that we can have a clear picture of who you are and what you do."

"A Domestika course usually has between two and four hours of content, and we recommend for at least 60% of that to be in video format, but we'll advise you in detail on all these topics in due time."

"The courses should be aimed at creating a project in any of the Domestika areas: photography and video, illustration, 3D and animation, marketing and business, design, calligraphy and typography, architecture and spaces, craft, web and app design, music and audio, writing, and fashion, etc."
